selection_approach_display.default: Applicants are assessed using the university's published selection score, which combines GCSE performance and UCAT.

by_selection_route.pathways_to_birmingham: Applicants on the completed Pathways to Birmingham Medicine guaranteed-interview route are not ranked by Birmingham's ordinary GCSE/UCAT selection score once the verified Pathways conditions are met.
by_selection_route.ukwpmed_guaranteed_interview: Eligible UKWPMED applicants receive a guaranteed interview and are not ranked using Birmingham's standard GCSE/UCAT selection score.

course.name: Medicine and Surgery MBChB
course.notes: Five-year A100 course. Graduates apply to A100 because A101 has been discontinued. The profile uses 2026 rules and 2027 rules where officially available; the interview page is explicitly labelled for 2026 entry and UKWPMED covers 2026 entry or deferred entry in 2027.

medical_school.name: Birmingham Medical School
medical_school.notes: Only officially evidenced, executable rules from the Phase 2 Birmingham research profile are represented as automatic production rules.

applicant_pools.name: Home contextual scored A100
applicant_pools.selection: Official application score out of 10 including the contextual component.

applicant_pools.name: Pathways to Birmingham guaranteed-interview route
applicant_pools.selection: Guaranteed interview when Routes to the Professions Medicine completion and the Pathways Medicine academic criteria are verified.

applicant_pools.name: UKWPMED guaranteed-interview route
applicant_pools.selection: Guaranteed interview only when canonical Step 6 programme completion and Birmingham Appendix 1 thresholds are all verified.

applicant_pools.name: Graduate A100
applicant_pools.selection: UCAT ranking after the graduate academic threshold.

applicant_pools.name: International A100
applicant_pools.selection: Academic threshold, UCAT ranking and manual non-academic review.

overall_policy.description: Eligibility is executable for the published A-level, International Baccalaureate, Scottish, Irish, standard graduate, listed English-language and UKWPMED routes represented below. Access, BTEC and Foundation routes are not accepted for standard A100 entry. Unlisted qualifications and any case requiring an unpublished waiver or exception are blocked or sent to manual review.
not_eligible_if: The applicant does not meet the applicable published academic minimum.
The applicant does not take UCAT in the application year, except where Birmingham has formally approved an access-arrangement exception.
The applicant offers an explicitly unsupported qualification or route.
A UKWPMED applicant does not meet Birmingham Appendix 1 thresholds.
manual_review_if: A graduate relies on a GCSE or A-level waiver based on degree content.
An applicant relies on an extenuating-circumstances resit exception.
An international qualification or combination is not explicitly represented.
A UCAT access-arrangement exception is claimed.
The evidence needed to verify contextual or UKWPMED status is incomplete.

gcse.sitting_policy: GCSE, A-level and equivalent resits are not considered unless Birmingham approves an official extenuating-circumstances exception. A Covid calculated grade at the first sitting does not count as a resit.

scoring_model.notes: The explanatory examples in research are not production fixtures or rules.

gcse.notes: The same GCSE eligibility minimums apply to contextual applicants.

programme_requirement.completion_status_limitation: Step 6 currently models completed, not successfully_completed. For Step 4A, completed is treated as the closest canonical evidence for completed/satisfactory R2P Medicine participation.

subject_combination_rules: Further Mathematics is not counted in addition to Mathematics.

degree_requirement.subject_scope: Any subject from a recognised institution

graduate.gcse_requirement: Normally A/B in Science, English and Mathematics.

waiver_rules.condition: GCSE requirements may be waived where degree content supports it.
A-level requirements may be waived where biomedical science content is more than 50% of the degree.

international.academic_standard: Equivalent to A*AA including Chemistry and a second science from Biology, Physics or Mathematics.
listed_accepted_routes: A-level route represented in this profile
International Baccalaureate route represented in this profile
Scottish route represented in this profile
Irish route represented in this profile

blocked_routes.reason: Birmingham does not consider Access courses for standard A100 entry.
Birmingham does not consider BTEC for standard A100 entry.
Birmingham does not consider Foundation programmes for standard A100 entry.

post_16.notes: No unlisted qualification route may be inferred from similarity to a supported route.

admissions_tests.validity_window: UCAT must be taken in the year of application.

exemptions.exception: A UCAT access arrangement that UCAT cannot accommodate may be considered only after Birmingham gives formal approval.

current_cycle_decile_boundaries.notes: Do not derive or invent current raw-score decile boundaries.

ucat.validity_window: UCAT must be taken in the year of application.

sjt.notes: SJT is ignored for eligibility and interview selection. Its separately evidenced post-interview use is recorded only under offer_selection.

resits.conditions: GCSE, A-level and equivalent resits are not considered unless Birmingham approves an official extenuating-circumstances exception.

extenuating_circumstances_exception.reason: The deterministic approval criteria are not published.

age_or_professional_checks.notes: No values are inferred because the Phase 2 evidence package did not establish these fields.

score_components.rounding: No official intermediate rounding rule is published; retain full precision.
score_components.notes: Raw maximum is 24 from five named subjects and two free-choice subjects.

score_components.calculation_method: Derive the UCAT decile through the shared lookup, preferring a university-specific table and otherwise using the global UCAT decile dataset, then map it to Birmingham's published 0-4 points table.
score_components.notes: The applicant supplies only their UCAT total. Decile lookup is internal and is not displayed on the result card.

score_components.calculation_method: Apply the POLAR4 points table only to an applicant whose contextual eligibility is verified.
score_components.notes: Do not infer contextual eligibility or postcode quintile.

total_score.notes: This formula applies to Home standard/contextual scoring only. No current hard cut-off is defined.

calculation.notes: Home scoring is deterministic after eligibility and contextual status are resolved and the shared engine can derive a UCAT decile from the applicant's raw score.

selection_adjustments.rule: Add the POLAR4 contextual component after contextual eligibility is verified. Do not reduce GCSE eligibility minimums.
Return guaranteed interview when canonical Step 6 evidence confirms completed Routes to the Professions Medicine participation and the Pathways Medicine GCSE, A-level and UCAT-taking gates are met.
Return guaranteed interview only when canonical Step 6 evidence confirms successful completion of a recognised UKWPMED programme and every Birmingham Appendix 1 threshold is verified.
After the graduate academic threshold is met, rank by UCAT cognitive total only. Do not score academic results and do not use GAMSAT.
After the international academic threshold is met, rank by UCAT cognitive total and complete the official non-academic personal-statement review manually.

stage_2_interview_selection.output_band_policy: No interview probability band is enabled in Phase 3. Eligibility, exact Home component scores and UKWPMED guaranteed-interview status may be returned only when all required applicant inputs and lookup evidence are present.
stage_2_interview_selection.notes: SJT is excluded from eligibility and interview selection, including Band 4. Historical score minima are guidance only and must never be executed as current cut-offs.

contextual_eligibility.notes: Birmingham A100 ordinary contextual eligibility is activated only from Step 6 evidence for Free School Meals during secondary education or local-authority care experience. POLAR4 is retained only for the later contextual interview-score component.

criteria.criterion: Received Free School Meals during secondary education.
Spent time in local authority care.

programme_evidence.completion_status_limitation: Step 6 currently models completed, not successfully_completed. For Step 4A, completed is treated as the closest canonical evidence for completed/satisfactory R2P Medicine participation.

pathways_academic_criteria.source_policy_note: The Routes to the Professions Medicine page specifies Chemistry plus a second science from Biology, Physics or Maths. This narrower official R2P Medicine stream rule is used for Pathways rather than the broader standard A100 Human Biology wording.

contextual_admissions.notes: Do not infer contextual or UKWPMED status. UKWPMED is a separate guaranteed-interview pathway, not the scored contextual route.

ranking_pools.name: Pathways to Birmingham guaranteed-interview pathway
ranking_factors: Verified completed Routes to the Professions Medicine programme evidence from Step 6
Pathways Medicine A-level predicted or final academic criteria
ranking_pools.notes: No UCAT threshold is inferred. This route bypasses ordinary Birmingham numerical ranking when all Pathways gates are met.

ranking_pools.name: Home standard and contextual scored selection
ranking_factors: Contextual POLAR4 score up to 1.5 where eligible
ranking_pools.notes: No current-cycle application-score threshold is known in advance. Contextual applicants use the same GCSE minimums.

ranking_pools.name: UKWPMED guaranteed-interview pathway
ranking_factors: Birmingham Appendix 1 academic and UCAT-taking thresholds
ranking_pools.notes: No UCAT threshold applies. Failure to meet Birmingham Appendix 1 means the applicant is not eligible for this WP route.

ranking_pools.name: Graduate A100 selection
ranking_factors: UCAT cognitive total after graduate academic threshold
ranking_pools.notes: GAMSAT is not used. Degree-content waiver cases require manual review.

ranking_pools.name: International selection
ranking_pools.notes: No GCSE/application-score formula applies. Unlisted or mixed qualifications require manual review.

quotas.name: Verified Home/International places (2027 entry)
quotas.notes: Home/International place figures verified by the ApplySmart admissions research team for 2027 entry.
Official 2025-entry historical places only. Do not assume these are the 2027 quota.

home.delivery: In person at Birmingham Medical School

interview_scoring.notes: This post-interview use of SJT does not make Band 4 an eligibility or interview-selection rejection.

offer_model.known_methodology_only: Offers use interview performance and the SJT component. Academic information is reconsidered only if needed for applicants tied on interview score.

tie_breakers.use: Only where applicants are tied on interview score and reconsideration is necessary.

standard_offer.required_subjects: Chemistry and a second science from Biology, Physics or Mathematics.

offer_selection.notes: Offer prediction is disabled. No unpublished station threshold, aggregate formula, tie-break value or waiting-list rule may be inferred.

cycles.notes: All figures are historical context only. Converted UCAT values are guidance and not official current-cycle cut-offs.

historical_admissions.notes: Historical admissions statistics and converted UCAT values must never be used as hard eligibility or interview-selection thresholds.

Used for the Pathways to Birmingham Medicine route: seven GCSEs with named subjects at 7755 in any order, Chemistry plus a second science from Biology, Physics or Maths, completion-triggered guaranteed interview for Medicine when academic criteria are met, and the Pathways alternative offer.

engine_assumptions: No historical threshold is used as a current decision rule.
Only the explicitly represented qualification routes are automatically evaluated.
UCAT decile is derived internally from the raw score through the shared university-specific-then-global lookup path.
do_not_infer: Do not reject SJT Band 4 at eligibility or interview-selection stage.
Do not use SJT for eligibility or interview selection.
Do not convert historical UCAT statistics into current hard cut-offs.
Do not invent current-cycle national UCAT decile boundaries.
Do not infer a graduate academic waiver from degree title or free text.

Do not accept unlisted or mixed international qualifications automatically.
